title: Casting Industry
description: Boost production efficiency, cost control and product quality with a dedicated ERP for casting and foundry businesses. From managing raw materials to tracking melt shop operations and dispatching final products, our specialized foundry ERP software provides end-to-end automation and real-time insights. Designed for jobbing, batch, and continuous foundries, this intelligent casting industry ERP solution helps streamline operations and reduce downtime across the board.

faqData.question: What is foundry ERP software?
faqData.answer: A complete ERP for casting & foundry industry helps manage everything from melting and molding to quality inspection and order dispatch, all within a unified system.

faqData.question: How does ERP improve inventory management for foundries?
faqData.answer: It tracks raw material usage, finished goods, scrap, and reusables in real-time ensuring accurate stock levels and optimizing purchases.

faqData.question: Can this ERP help with batch-wise production tracking?
faqData.answer: Yes, we do integrated production tracking system enables stage-wise monitoring, including heat-wise and lot-wise traceability.
